title: Service Tier Model
definition: A business strategy that organizes services into distinct tiers based on quality, price, and features.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine a restaurant menu with three sections: basic, premium, and gourmet. Each section offers a unique experience at a different price point.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The Service Tier Model categorizes offerings into tiers, such as The Bespoke Detailer's Bespoke Renewal, Executive Refresher, and Signature Refresher services. Each tier provides a specific level of service and value.
difficulty_levels.expert: The Service Tier Model can be considered a form of price discrimination, leveraging consumer perception of value. It has implications in market segmentation, pricing strategy, and customer loyalty. It is also related to the concept of bundling, where a bundle of services is offered at a lower price than the individual services.

extra_fields.insight: The Bespoke Detailer's Service Tier Model caters to different consumer segments by offering a range of services at varying price points.
